styleExtraction.notes: Each scene contains a reusable 1-2 sentence scene prompt and a fixed four-part 15-second storyboard. Generation concatenates prompts only and does not upload reference videos.

materials.title: Scene 1 | Dealership Overview

styleJson.sceneStyle: Real used-car dealership introduction style. The digital human appears naturally as a sales consultant; the camera first establishes the store or lot environment, then moves to vehicle rows and the in-store viewing atmosphere. Keep the image clean, credible, and realistic with a medium 15-second pacing.
styleJson.visualTone: Realistic used-car short-video look; clean, credible, and free of invented vehicle facts.
